spans.s: ध्यै vt. 1P (pp. ध्यात; pres. ध्यायति; desid. दिध्यासति; pass. ध्यायते) To think of, to meditate, to reflect upon, to ponder over, to imagine, to recollect, ध्यायतो विषयान् पुंसः Bg.ii.62, ध्यायंति चान्यं धिया Panch.i., चिरमनुचरो राजराजस्य दध्यौ Megh.i.3.With अनु-, to think of, to remember, to wish well to, R.xiv.60.With अप-, to disregard.With अभि-, to desire, Yaj.iii.134.With अव-, to disregard.With नि-, 1. to think of, to remember, Bt.xiv.65; 2. to meditate deeply upon.With निस्-, to think of, to meditate upon.
